info.title: VetLink API
info.description: REST API for the VetLink mobile and web apps. USSD, SMS and M-Pesa webhooks are not part of this document. Errors are `{ code, message_key, details }`; `message_key` maps into the shared i18n package.

post.summary: Request a vet (created in pending_payment)
post.description:
Access: role `farmer`.

Idempotent per farmer and `Idempotency-Key`: a retry returns the same booking with 200; the same key with a different request is 422. The fee is always quoted by the server.

wardId.description: Defaults to the farmer's saved ward

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Required. 8 to 128 chars [A-Za-z0-9_:-]; generate on tap, reuse on retry

post.summary: Pay the booking deposit: sends an M-Pesa prompt to my phone
post.description:
Access: role `farmer`.

Returns the in-flight or already-paid deposit instead of sending a second prompt. The amount is set by the server. Poll the payment or the booking for the result; the client never marks a payment successful.
